scene.prompt: Constantinople: the great dome of Hagia Sophia, the Theodosian land walls and the Golden Horn crowded with ships
Thessalonica: sea walls on the Thermaic Gulf, the basilica of Saint Demetrios and the arch of Galerius
Nicaea in Bithynia: square city walls by the shore of Lake Askania, olive groves and wooded hills
Trebizond on the Black Sea: a walled citadel between two ravines, green Pontic mountains and a harbor full of galleys
